Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain post basketball injury.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 3 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Osteochondral impaction injury with accompanying bone marrow edema along the sulcus terminalis of the lateral femoral condyle with additional small osseous contusions along the posterior medial and lateral tibial plateaus. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No ossified intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal full thickness cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Osteochondral impaction injury along the lateral femoral condyle; otherwise, no focal full-thickness cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal full-thickness cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete midsubstance rupture.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Intact

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intrasubstance and periligamentous edema consistent with grade 2 sprain.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Intact; mild periligamentous edema along the fibular collateral ligament consistent with grade 1 sprain with additional mild periligamentous and intrasubstance edema involving the proximal popliteus tendon consistent with grade 2 sprain.
Posterolateral corner structures: Grade 1 sprain of the fibular collateral ligament with additional grade 2 sprain of the proximal popliteus tendon. Additional grade 1-2 sprain of the popliteal fibular ligament.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No high-grade tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No high-grade tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Mild periligamentous edema at its femoral attachment likely related to the adjacent MCL injury.
Patellofemoral tracking: No suspicious edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Minor lateral patellar tilt without significant translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.   

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Mild subcutaneous and deep soft tissue edema on a posttraumatic basis.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complete midsubstance ACL rupture. Accompanying osteochondral impaction injury along the lateral femoral condyle and small osseous contusions along the posterior medial and lateral tibial plateaus.
2. Intact medial and lateral menisci.
3. Grade 2 MCL sprain.

Síndrome meniscal medial.

Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.

Edema de las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Condropatía focal grado 4 del aspecto inferior de la vertiente medial de la tróclea femoral.
Condropatía superficial de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
